purpose: Additional wide-range non-regression check for the increased up_show dynamic shared allocation; never changes the fixed primary metric or gates.
entry_gate: Only after E020 fixed primary three-pair qualification passes, exact state checks pass and independent raw audit passes. If primary fails, retain this protocol as terminally inapplicable, with zero holdout executions.
stop_rule: Exactly the original primary loop: first every20 check at or below0.3% of starting pot, otherwise stop at400 and fail quality. Same checks/discounts for both arms. No outcome-driven limit, target, storage, menu, range, cache policy or sample-count edits.
source_delta: Only the exact D037 two-file cache candidate: kernels.cu07565169... and mod.rsce71fa3b...; full SHA identities copied alongside.

harness_plan.kind: one tiny independent fixed holdout integration-test/standalone evaluator, prepared and reviewed additively only if entry gate passes
harness_plan.reuse: Reuse frozen-primary.rs lifecycle boundaries, convergence loop and state_fingerprint/fingerprint_store/Fingerprint helper text unchanged. Replace only fixed fixture selection/config loading with fixture.json; add bounded admission and exact state artifact output after timing. Keep original checkout evaluator and all control workloads byte-identical.
harness_plan.why_not_existing_cli: solve-cli accepts JSON but GPU mode forces F32, synchronizes every iteration, uses check10 in single mode, lacks complete-cycle measurement and exact full-state output; existing postflop perf/state tests hardcode narrow inputs. Do not label those timings equivalent.
harness_plan.minimum_new_code: one fixed case, no parameter sweep, no profiler, no new kernel/lifecycle API, no numerical algorithm rewrite
harness_plan.source_freeze: Freeze identical evaluator/helper/config bytes for E015 and E020 before any holdout native run. Root seals concrete command/runID/binary/manifest/rlib bindings and independent review; this protocol does not authorize unreviewed execution.

timing.start: before Spot build and CPU arena allocation
timing.end: after complete GPU readback and synchronization
excluded: post-timing fingerprints and exact state file output
secondary: external process wall_ms including teardown (also includes exact-state evidence; diagnostic only)
timing.warm_cache_note: Fresh process per run, existing persistent driver cache retained; no cache resets or selective warmup. This is not a cold-cache qualification.

holdout_resource_check: If the entry gate passes, before six timings root performs one separately archived no-launch query using the exact D037 baseline/candidate CUDA and compilation options at this actual nh=1128/m_max=1081 shape: baseline dynamic13160 and candidate21808 bytes. Record actual registers/static shared/maxthreads/occupancy, without a conditional rescue or altered workload. Native GpuPlan counts independently bind the formula to the fixture; the prior1326 occupancy5->3 is only the motivation.

arms.B: accepted E015 compiled against identical holdout evaluator
arms.C: exact E020 two-file candidate compiled against identical holdout evaluator

cohort_policy: Exactly three fresh processes per binary, all retained. No trimming, retries, rescoring, cohort extension or favorable restart. Operational errors stop this protocol for independent review with evidence retained; failed numerical/quality/performance outcomes are not operational retries.

exactness.checks: All every20 exploit_bits, stopping iteration, target_met and all config/algorithm/storage/iso/count fields exact across all six runs; finite exploit and target reached in all.
exactness.state: After timed full readback, compare all four CPU stores including every I16/U16 q word and every f32 scale bit, all lengths/type tags, root_strategy_bits and full state_fingerprint object. Use primary helper fingerprints plus streaming framed raw store bytes to a new per-run state.bin, compared byte-for-byte with bounded host buffers; SHA256 is provenance, not a substitute for byte comparison.
exactness.scope: Exact full compressed CPU learning state and exploitability, not raw unsynchronized GPU float buffers. Existing broader F32/state/menu/resume controls remain mandatory separately.

gate.reject: Reject unconditional E020 adoption if median slowdown strictly>3% AND paired slowdown strictly>3% in at least2of3 pairs.
gate.correctness: Any exactness mismatch or target failure prevents qualification regardless of timing.
gate.ambiguity: Retain all timing ranges and pair values. Passing this bounded guard does not prove equivalence or absence of all broad-range regressions; no statistical-significance claim.
gate.no_rescue: No automatic threshold-based cache path, conditional kernel rescue, or hidden fixture-specific optimization. A future different candidate requires its own prospective evidence.

admission.serialization: Root only, one build or GPU process at a time under existing gpu-run.lock; existing live-solve GET-only refusal before each run; no server mutation.
admission.device: RTX5090, total>=30GiB and free>=4GiB before child; stop rather than downgrade engine/device/ranges.
admission.checks: Spot::new_with_limit(config,Some(20000)); assert hands[1128,1128], nodes<=11691 and public estimate<=2GiB before Solver allocation. Inspect existing Spot.river.get for all48 legal single-river Dealt values: assert each sorted player count1081 and record max1081 plus both show_shared formulas. Report tree_bytes and arena_bytes_for(Compressed). Keep these small admission checks inside timed construction; do not build a duplicate GpuPlan or context. GpuSolver::new_with_budget(&host,2GiB) performs its existing checked planned-buffer budget test before device allocation and must succeed. No CPU fallback, no second simultaneous solver. Unexpected shape is invalid.
admission.memory_note: source-derived public estimate upper bound is below1GiB including existing512MiB slack, so2GiB budget and4GiB free gate are deliberately conservative on32GiB device. Native measured allocation still required; estimate is not measured residency.
admission.timeouts: Root runner fixes build timeout1800s and each native process600s before execution, file stdout/stderr,10s heartbeat, explicit child cleanup inside lock. No GPU telemetry polling during native timing; pre/post only.

publication: Separate holdout report/evidence; never alter original fixture medians or accepted gains from these timings. Acceptance remains root decision after all primary, broad controls and holdout gates. Deployment separate.
limits: One deliberately broad turn fixture, not all ranges/menus/hardware.
No actual holdout occupancy or performance measured during preparation.
No source/fixture result tuning after primary or holdout outcomes.
